all you need: 1 cup water, 1/2 cup oil, 3 eggs 1. set oven to 350°f. coat bottom of pan with no-stick cooking spray or shortening and a flour dusting. for cupcakes, use paper baking cups. 2. combine cake mix, water, oil and eggs in large bowl; mix until moistened. beat with mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. pour batter into pan(s). we recommend using crisco oil. 3. bake at 350°f. follow the bake times below. when toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, cake is done. cool 10 to 15 minutes before removing from pan. cool cake completely before frosting. store loosely covered. for 13 x 9-inch pan, bake 34 to 38 min. ; for two 8-inch round pans, bake 34 to 38 min.; two 9-inch round pans, bake 29 to 33 min.; for 24 cupcakes (1/2 full), bake 19 to 23 min. if desired, substitute 4 egg whites or ½ cup egg substitute for the eggs.

all you need: 1 stick (1/2 cup) of butter, 1 egg 1. set you oven to 375°f. *for best results, butter should be completely softened or slight melted. to soften butter directly from the refrigerator, heat in microwave unwrapped for 10 to 15 seconds. margarine or spread may be used in place of butter. 2. combine cookie mix, softened butter and egg in medium bowl. mix until soft dough is formed. form dough by rounded teaspoons. place onto ungreased baking sheet 2 inches apart. 3. back at 375°f 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are set. allow to cool for 2 minutes before removing from baking sheet. store cookies in airtight container.
